title: The Transplant Surgeon
summary: A surgeon has five patients who will die without transplants: each needs a different organ, and there are no donors. A healthy young man comes in for a check-up, and he is a match for all five. Should the surgeon kill him and save five? Almost everyone says no, even though the numbers are the same as in the trolley case, where most people think diverting the trolley is permissible. Judith Jarvis Thomson used the case to ask what makes the two different.
